title: Gus and the Pig
lines: Gus got a pup and a pig.
The pup can tug. The pig can dig.
The pig dug and dug in the mud.
The pig dug up a tin mug!
"It is not a fig," said Gus.
A fig is in the mug!
Gus did pat the pig and the pup.

questions.ask: What did the pig dig up?
questions.listenFor: A tin mug. The story says it. If your child is unsure, have them find the word mug and read that line again.

questions.ask: Was Gus happy at the end? How can you tell?
questions.listenFor: Yes - he patted the pig and the pup. Listen for the pat, and for the fig turning up inside the mug after all.

questions.ask: What do you think the pig will dig up next? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Any answer works. You are listening for a reason - the pig likes figs, or the pig digs in mud, so it will come up muddy.
